title.en: When and while: past continuous and past simple

ex.ko: 내가 도착했을 때 그는 요리하고 있었어요.
ex.en: When I arrived, he was cooking.
While I was sleeping, the phone rang.

ex.ko: 우리가 도착했을 때 비가 오고 있었어요.
ex.en: When we arrived, it was raining.
I fell while I was walking.

ex.t: Vi a un amigo mientras esperaba el autobús.
ex.en: I saw a friend while I was waiting for the bus.

ex.t: De repente se apagó la luz.
Vi un accidente en la calle.
ex.en: I saw an accident in the street.

title.ko: imperfecto (acción larga) + pretérito (acción corta); cuando / mientras
title.en: imperfect (long action) + preterite (short action); cuando / mientras

explain.ko: 긴 배경 행동은 불완료과거(estaba cenando, leía), 갑자기 일어난 짧은 행동은 부정과거(llamaste, sonó)로 말합니다. cuando는 '~했을 때', mientras는 '~하는 동안'입니다: Mientras leía, sonó el teléfono. 두 행동이 동시에 진행되면 mientras 양쪽에 불완료과거를 씁니다.
explain.en: Use the imperfect for a long background action (estaba cenando, leía) and the preterite for a short interrupting one (llamaste, sonó). Cuando = when, mientras = while: Mientras leía, sonó el teléfono. For two simultaneous actions use the imperfect on both sides of mientras.

lines.t: ¿Qué estabas haciendo cuando sonó el teléfono?

trans.ko: (질문) 전화가 울렸을 때 뭐 하고 있었어요?
trans.en: (Question) What were you doing when the phone rang?

lines.t: Ayer vi un accidente en la calle.
Estaba esperando el autobús. De repente un coche golpeó una moto.

trans.ko:
A: 어제 길에서 사고를 봤어.
B: 정말? 그때 뭐 하고 있었어?
A: 버스를 기다리고 있었어. 갑자기 차가 오토바이와 부딪쳤어.
B: 다친 사람은 없었어?
trans.en:
A: I saw an accident in the street yesterday.
B: Really? What were you doing?
A: I was waiting for the bus. Suddenly a car hit a motorbike.
B: Was anybody hurt?

questions.q: ¿Qué hacía A cuando ocurrió el accidente?

lines.t: Ayer por la mañana estaba paseando por el parque. Mientras paseaba, vi a un amigo. Cuando estábamos hablando, de repente empezó a llover. Corrimos a casa.

trans.ko: 어제 아침에 나는 공원에서 걷고 있었어요. 걷는 동안 친구를 봤어요. 우리가 이야기하고 있을 때 갑자기 비가 오기 시작했어요. 우리는 집으로 달려갔어요.
trans.en: Yesterday morning I was walking in the park. While I was walking, I saw a friend. When we were talking, it suddenly started to rain. We ran home.

lines.t: A las tres de la tarde. Estaba caminando.
Un coche azul se saltó el semáforo en rojo.

trans.ko:
직원: 사고는 언제 일어났어요?
손님: 오후 3시쯤이었어요. 저는 걷고 있었어요.
직원: 무엇을 봤어요?
손님: 파란 차가 신호를 무시했어요.
trans.en:
Clerk: When did the accident happen?
Guest: At about three in the afternoon. I was walking.
Clerk: What did you see?
Guest: A blue car went through the red light.

trans.ko: 1) 내가 도착했을 때 그는 요리하고 있었어요. 2) 내가 자는 동안 전화가 울렸어요. 3) 걷다가 넘어졌어요.
trans.en: 1) When I arrived, he was cooking. 2) While I was sleeping, the phone rang. 3) I fell while I was walking.

trans.en: Yesterday morning I was walking in the park. While I was walking, I saw a friend. When we were talking, it suddenly started to rain.

items.passage: Tom estaba esperando el autobús. Entonces vio a un viejo amigo. Hablaron durante una hora.

trans.ko: 톰은 버스를 기다리고 있었어요. 그때 그는 오랜 친구를 봤어요. 그들은 한 시간 동안 이야기했어요.
trans.en: Tom was waiting for the bus. Then he saw an old friend. They talked for an hour.

prompt.ko: 과거진행형과 과거형으로 어제 일어난 일을 3문장으로 써 보세요 (when / while 사용).
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences about something that happened yesterday using the past continuous and the past simple (with when / while).

task.model: Cuando llegué al colegio, estaba lloviendo. Mientras esperaba el autobús, vi a un amigo. De repente dejó de llover.

model_trans.ko: 내가 학교에 도착했을 때 비가 오고 있었어요. 버스를 기다리는 동안 친구를 봤어요. 갑자기 비가 그쳤어요.
model_trans.en: When I arrived at school, it was raining. While I was waiting for the bus, I saw a friend. Suddenly the rain stopped.
